title: C4/X4: Batch deletes may not export to CloudKit (resurrection risk)

description: purgeAll/AutoPurgeJob use NSBatchDeleteRequest directly against the live NSPersistentCloudKitContainer store. Batch operations bypass the managed-object graph; if NSPersistentCloudKitContainer does not export these deletions the way it exports context-level deletes, an emptied Trash can re-import from the CloudKit zone — purged tasks resurrect. Corroborated independently by both the stores sweep (C4) and the cross-process sweep (X4): purged-task CKRecords are never explicitly retired, resurrected rows have no local same-id row for TaskDuplicateReconciler to heal, and this has been possible in PRODUCTION DATA since the 2026-06-24 Production cutover. COUNCIL-VOTE DECISION (2026-07-28, 3-0 unanimous): filed as ONE merged story for both C4 and X4 (same code change, same file, same verification caveat) rather than two linked stories — see .council/c4-x4-merged-or-two-linked-stories/DECISION.md for the full audit trail. Fix: batch delete -> mirrored chunked context deletes on makeBackgroundContext() (documented Apple limitation with mirrored-context deletes). Verification (CloudKit Console audit for orphaned/purged records) is OPPORTUNISTIC for Mikey, NOT a gate on the fix. Severity: Critical. Wave/Plan: Wave 1, plan 1b purge-cloudkit-retirement. Sweep: stores + cross-process (independently corroborated by both sweeps).
